title: Storm Water Construction Site Urgent
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report an illicit discharge, sediment tracking, solid waste pollution or any other environmental concern pertaining to a Construction site going into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.
instructions: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report an illicit discharge, sediment tracking, solid waste pollution or any other environmental concern pertaining to a Construction site going into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. Please call 311 for more information.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about stormwater pollution from a construction site.
actions.why: For an illicit discharge, sediment tracking, solid waste pollution, or another environmental concern from a construction site entering a street, alley, ditch, creek, lake, river, or storm drain. This request must be dispatched, and the saved instructions direct people to call 311.
